name: ZuriQ
description: ZuriQ is an ETH Zurich spin-off developing a novel two-dimensional trapped-ion quantum computing architecture. Unlike conventional one-dimensional ion chain designs, ZuriQ uses combined electric and magnetic fields to allow ions to move freely in two dimensions on a quantum chip, addressing the qubit-scaling limitations of current trapped-ion systems.

products.name: 2D Trapped-Ion Quantum Chip
products.description: Novel two-dimensional trapped-ion architecture using combined electric and magnetic fields for free ion movement on a quantum chip

highlights: ETH Zurich spin-off pioneering 2D ion-trap architecture

Unique approach using combined electric and magnetic fields for two-dimensional ion control

sources.title: ZuriQ Raises $4.2 Million to Break Quantum Computing's Scaling Barrier - The Quantum Insider

news.title: ZuriQ Raises $4.2 Million to Break Quantum Computing's Scaling Barrier
news.excerpt: ZuriQ has raised $4.2 million to commercialize a new trapped-ion architecture, enabling scalable quantum computing through a unique combination of electric and magnetic fields. The seed funding round was led by Founderful with participation from SquareOne, First Momentum Ventures, OnSight Ventures and QAI Ventures.
